**Finding submitted: deviation (Section 13.5, ¶p0115–p0116).**

- **Issue:** Section 13.5 correctly gives Corio ownership of Developments created solely by Corio (with Commerce One assigning any residual claim), but the carve-out "*unless such Developments are supported on an ongoing basis by Commerce One in which case Commerce One will retain all ownership rights*" transfers IP created by our own personnel to the Vendor, with no licence back — walk-away territory under the IP rule and short of the fallback.
- **Redline (validated, preferred position):** delete the carve-out so Developments are owned by Corio, subject to Commerce One's pre-existing ownership; Commerce One's ownership of the Software under 2.8 is untouched. Fallback offered in the comment: a support-purposes licence to Commerce One instead of ownership.
- **Noted, not flagged:** no express Customer Data ownership sentence (data sits only under the Section 10 confidentiality/NDA regime), and ownership of enhancements to the Software itself is deferred to future negotiation.
